title: Metric-Log Correlator and Adaptive Pager Throttling
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: build a lightweight correlator service and pipeline rules that join metric anomalies, traces, and recent logs into enriched alert payloads, and implement an adaptive pager throttling layer that reduces noisy on-call paging during correlated partial degradations.

Scope:
- Add tracing hook extension points to annotate spans with service-level fingerprints and KV-cache hit/miss metadata.
- Extend metric ingestion to emit short-lived anomaly events (windowed z-score + seasonal baseline).
- Implement a streaming correlator (stateless microservice) that consumes metric anomaly events, recent trace summaries, and log snippets to compute a composite severity and confidence score.
- Wire composited scores into burn-rate alert evaluator so alerts can be suppressed, grouped, or routed based on confidence and customer-impact weights.
- Adaptive pager throttling: introduce time-windowed backoff that uses composite confidence and historical pager fatigue to delay lower-confidence pages, escalate only if degradation persists or confidence increases.

Non-goals: full retraining of anomaly models or long-term log reindexing. This is focused on real-time enrichment and lightweight decisioning next to alert evaluation.

Success criteria:
- Mean pages/hour for non-critical P1 alerts reduced by >= 30% in a 2-week A/B test without increasing Mean Time To Severity (MTTS) by > 15%.
- Average alert payload size stays under 120KB after enrichment.
- No RUO (regression) on SLO burn-rate evaluation latency (alert eval latency increase < 5%).

Deliverables: architecture doc, correlator service (k8s), trace hook PR, metric anomaly producer, console dashboard updates (latency/error correlation view), runbook updates for oncall.

Artifacts: Confluence design doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OBS/metric-log-correlator , spike notebook: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/spikes/metric-log-correlator , draft dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/obs/metric-log-correlator
